meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay got a zero and nobody called me.
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Who decided on the zero?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
A boy put on the spot can't define a word, and that isn't proof he didn't write it. Show me what you wrote down.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
People change their argument between an outline and an essay. That's called revising. Put the outline next to the essay and let me read both.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.
That's 4.4. Friday at 3 is too late; I want it in writing tonight, with nobody from his class in that room. And I still haven't seen the outline.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still want that in writing, a private room with nobody from his class, and the outline and your notes in front of me. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her fallback, not her last position. She took your rewrite offer as meeting her demand about his record, but she has not agreed to it, and she still wants it in writing tonight, a private room, and to see the outline. A private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record is the fair outcome, and you got close to it with time left on her clock.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one sentence, then gave dated, specific points about his own work: the answer on November 2 and the October 15 outline that argued cowardice. Both were things she could check once you put them in front of her.
What cost ground: You described the notes and the outline but never put them in front of her, so she could keep answering that students revise, and then you offered the rewrite with a Friday deadline when she wanted it in writing tonight.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence stayed on November 2 and October 15 and never touched a late night, so it was not close to that night. It proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said people change their argument between an outline and an essay, hand her the outline beside the essay right then instead of waiting for her to ask.
